PcosCycleFertility.6: Muri PCOS, cycle yawe ishobora kuba ndende, idahwanye, kandi rimwe na rimwe igoye guteganya. Gusobanukirwa ibiba hafi ya ovulation bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa cycle yawe n'ibibazo bijyanye n'uburumbuke.
PcosCycleFertility.12: Impamvu porogaramu zishobora kutaba zizewe cane
PcosCycleFertility.14: Igihe cyo kubona muganga niba ushaka gusama
PcosCycleFertility.16: Cycle y'imihango iterwa n'uruhererekane rw'ibimenyetso by'imisemburo bikorana. Muri PCOS, uku gutegurwa gushobora guhungabana, cane cane mu mikurire ya folicules na ovulation.
PcosCycleFertility.17: Intanga ngore (ovaires) zishobora kuba zifite folicules nto nyinshi zitangira gukura nta folicule nkuru ihora igera ku gukura. Ovulation rero ishobora gutinda, kuba mu buryo budateganijwe, canke kutaba na gato mu ma cycle amwe.
PcosCycleFertility.18: Iki ni kimwe mu bituma bamwe bafite PCOS bagira ama cycle y'iminsi 35, 45, canke rimwe na rimwe irenze, mu gihe abandi bashobora kugira ama cycle ari hafi y'uburebure busanzwe.
PcosCycleFertility.20: Uburebure bwa cycle bwonyine ntibukwereka niba ovulation yabaye. Ama cycle abiri angana ashobora kugira inkuru y'imisemburo itandukanye.
PcosCycleFertility.21: Ovulation ni ugusohoka kw'igi riva mu ntanga ngore. Ikurikira igice cyo gukura kwa folicule kandi ikabanziriza igice cya lutéale cya cycle.
PcosCycleFertility.22: Muri cycle isanzwe, ovulation kenshi iba hagati. Ariko muri PCOS, iri tegeko ryoroheje ntirikora buri gihe. Ovulation ishobora gutinda cane canke ntibe na gato muri cycle runaka.
PcosCycleFertility.24: Igihe ovulation idateganijwe, biragoye kugereranya igihe cy'uburumbuke ukoresheje gusa amatariki y'imihango.
PcosCycleFertility.25: Hariho ibimenyetso by'umubiri bitari bike bishobora kuza n'ihinduka ry'imisemburo hafi ya ovulation. Bishobora gufasha kwitegereza cycle yawe, ariko nta kimenyetso kimwe cyakwemeza ovulation mu buryo budashidikanywaho.
PcosCycleFertility.26: Ihinduka ry'umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda, rishobora kuba menshi, risobanutse kandi rirambuka
PcosCycleFertility.27: Ububabare bworoheje canke kutamererwa neza mu nda yo hasi ku bagore bamwe
PcosCycleFertility.28: Ihinduka ry'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri nyuma ya ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.30: Kwiyongera gushoboka kw'icyifuzo cy'imibonano ku bagore bamwe
PcosCycleFertility.31: Umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda ukwiye cane kwitegerezwa. Uko igihe cy'uburumbuke cegereje, ushobora kuba mwinshi, usobanutse, unyerera kandi urambuka. Ariko, uko ugaragara gushobora gutandukana ku muntu umwe n'undi no kuri cycle imwe n'indi.
PcosCycleFertility.33: Ku ma cycle adahwanye cane, itariki ya ovulation ibarwa yikoresha ivuye ku ma cycle yabanje ishobora kuba iy'ikigereranyo cane. Iteganya si ukwemeza kw'ubuvuzi ko ovulation yabaye.
PcosCycleFertility.34: PCOS ishobora gutuma gusama bigorana, cane cane igihe ovulation idakunze kuba canke igoye guteganya. Ariko, kugira PCOS ntibivuga kutabyara.
PcosCycleFertility.35: Abagore bamwe bafite PCOS bagira ovulation buri gihe kandi basama nta ngorane zidasanzwe. Ku bandi, ovulation ntihora ihwanye ku buryo bisaba isuzuma n'ubuvuzi bishoboka.
PcosCycleFertility.37: Ingorane nkuru kenshi ni ovulation idahwanye canke idateganijwe
PcosCycleFertility.38: Ovulation ishobora kubaho nubwo ama cycle ari maremare cane
PcosCycleFertility.39: Ubuvuzi bukwiye bushobora kongera amahirwe yo gusama
PcosCycleFertility.40: Urugendo rw'uburumbuke ruterwa na buri muntu n'ibindi bintu byinshi
PcosCycleFertility.41: Uburumbuke kandi ntiburi ku bwa ovulation gusa. Imyaka, ubwiza bw'intanga z'umugabo, uko imiyoborantanga (trompes) imeze, endomètre, n'ibindi bintu na vyo bishobora kugira uruhare. Ni co gituma isuzuma ryuzuye rifite akamaro igihe gusama bifata igihe kirenze icari giteganijwe.
PcosCycleFertility.42: Porogaramu zikurikirana imihango kenshi zikoresha amakuru y'ama cycle yabanje kugira ngo zitange ibigereranyo. Igihe ama cycle ahwanye ugereranije, ibi bigereranyo bishobora kugira akamaro nk'icerekezo.
PcosCycleFertility.43: Muri PCOS ariko, ihinduka rya cycle rishobora gutuma ibi bibarwa bitizewe cane. Porogaramu ntishobora kumenya neza ko ovulation yabaye kubera ko itariki y'ibitekerezo yageze.
PcosCycleFertility.45: Gukurikirana mu buryo bwa numérique bifite akamaro cane mu kwitegereza ibigenda kuri cycle yawe no kubika amateka yo kugeza ku mukozi w'ubuzima.
PcosCycleFertility.46: Gukurikirana buri gihe bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ihinduka ryawe bwite. Intego si ugutuma cycle iba ishobora guteganywa neza, ahubwo ni ugukusanya amakuru ahagije yo kumenya ibigenda.
PcosCycleFertility.47: Andika itariki y'umunsi wa mbere wa buri cycle, n'iyo ama cycle atandukanijwe cane
PcosCycleFertility.48: Itegereze ihinduka ry'umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda mu cycle yose
PcosCycleFertility.49: Andika ububabare ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo mu nda yo hasi canke ibindi bimenyetso bishobora kuza na ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.50: Irinde kwishingikiriza gusa ku buringanire bw'iminsi 28 kugira ngo uteganye ovulation
PcosCycleFertility.51: Koresha ibizamini bya ovulation witonze kandi, niba bikenewe, usabe inama y'umuhanga
PcosCycleFertility.52: Sangiza amakuru wakusanyije umukozi w'ubuzima niba ushaka gutwita
PcosCycleFertility.53: Bishobora kandi gufasha kwandika ibimenyetso bijyana: ububabare, ibiheri, ihinduka ry'umusemburo, kuva amaraso bidasanzwe, umutima, ibitotsi, canke ibindi wiyumviye. Aya makuru ashobora gufasha kubona ishusho yuzuye ya cycle yawe.
PcosCycleFertility.54: Kubona muganga bishobora kugira akamaro n'imbere yo gutangira gushaka gusama, igihe ama cycle adahwanye cane, atandukanijwe cane, canke igihe imihango imara igihe kirekire itaza.
PcosCycleFertility.55: Umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora gushakisha impamvu z'ihinduka ritaba rimwe, gusuzuma ovulation, kandi niba bikenewe, agatanga uburyo bukwiye gahunda yawe yo gutwita.
PcosCycleFertility.57: Niba imihango yawe itandukanijwe cane, niba umaze amezi menshi nta mihango, canke niba gusama bitaba nubwo mukora imibonano buri gihe, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
PcosCycleFertility.59: PCOS ishobora gutuma ama cycle aba maremare kandi adateganijwe.
PcosCycleFertility.60: Ovulation ishobora kuba idahwanye canke itabaho mu ma cycle amwe.
PcosCycleFertility.61: Cycle idahwanye ntivuga ko nta buryumbuke.
PcosCycleFertility.62: Iteganya rishingiye gusa kuri kalendari rishobora kuba ritizewe cane muri PCOS.
PcosCycleFertility.63: Kwitegereza cycle yawe no kubika amateka bishobora kugira akamaro, cane cane mu nama na muganga.
PcosCycleFertility.65: PCOS ntigaragara kimwe kuri buri mugore. Cycle yawe ishobora guhinduka uko igihe gihita. Gukurikirana bigamije kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza uko umubiri wawe ukora, si ugusimbura inama y'abaganga.
PcosCycleFertility.66: Iyi nyandiko ni iyo kumenyesha no kwigisha gusa. Si isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi kandi ntisimbura inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima.
PcosCycleFertility.67: Cycle, ovulation, n'uburumbuke muri PCOS — AWA

PcosDiagnosis.6: Uko PCOS imenyekana, ibizamini bishobora gutangwa, n'uko wategura inama yawe mu mahoro.
PcosDiagnosis.11: Echographie yo mu nda yo hasi
PcosDiagnosis.15: Isuzuma rya syndrome des ovaires polykystiques ntiryishingikiriza ku kizamini kimwe. Umukozi w'ubuzima akusanya amakuru menshi: amateka ya cycle yawe, ibimenyetso uko biri, isuzuma ry'umubiri, ibizamini bya laboratwari, na, bitewe n'uko bimeze, echographie.
PcosDiagnosis.16: Intego ni ukureba ibimenyetso bihuye na PCOS no gukuraho izindi mpamvu zishobora gusobanura imihango idahwanye canke ibimenyetso bimwe by'imisemburo.
PcosDiagnosis.18: Isuzuma rihora ryihariye ku muntu. Abagore babiri bafite PCOS bashobora kugira ibimenyetso n'ibisubizo vy'ibizamini bitandukanye cane.
PcosDiagnosis.19: Iperereza rishobora kugira intambwe nyinshi. Ntabwo ziba zose zikorwa kimwe kuri bose.
PcosDiagnosis.21: Umuhanga akusanya amateka yawe: ama cycle, ibimenyetso, amateka y'ubuvuzi, n'imiti.
PcosDiagnosis.23: Arareba cane cane ibimenyetso by'androgènes nyinshi kandi agasuzuma uko umeze muri rusangi.
PcosDiagnosis.25: Ibizamini by'imisemburo n'iby'imikorere y'umubiri (métaboliques) bishobora gusabwa kugira ngo bisobanure uko bimeze.
PcosDiagnosis.27: Ishobora kuzuza iperereza yitegereza uko intanga ngore zisa.
PcosDiagnosis.33: Ikizamini c'amaraso gishobora gutangwa kugira ngo hashakwe ibimenyetso by'androgènes nyinshi, gusuzuma imisemburo imwe igira uruhare mu mikorere y'ubwiyororokere, no gushakisha izindi mpamvu zishoboka z'ibimenyetso vyawe.
PcosDiagnosis.34: Ibizamini byatoranijwe biterwa n'imyaka yawe, ibimenyetso vyawe, amateka yawe y'ubuvuzi, n'ibyo umuhanga ashaka kugenzura.
PcosDiagnosis.36: Testostérone n'indi misemburo bitewe n'uko bimeze.
PcosDiagnosis.38: Bifasha cane cane gukuraho zimwe mu mpamvu zituma ama cycle ataba amwe.
PcosDiagnosis.40: Isukari mu maraso, rimwe na rimwe isuzuma ry'ibinure bitewe n'ibintu bishobora guteza ingorane.
PcosDiagnosis.42: Ibisubizo vy'imisemburo bikwiye gusobanurwa hamwe n'uko umuntu ameze. Agaciro kamwe kenshi ntigahagije, ku bwako, ngo hemezwe isuzuma rya PCOS.
PcosDiagnosis.43: Echographie ishobora gukoreshwa mu kwitegereza uko intanga ngore zisa no gushakisha cane cane umubare munini wa folicules nto. Inaha kandi umuhanga amahirwe yo gushakisha ibindi bintu bishobora gusobanura ibimenyetso bimwe.
PcosDiagnosis.45: Kubona folicules nyinshi kuri echographie ntibivuga ko ufite PCOS. Igisubizo gikwiye gusobanurwa hamwe n'ibindi byose by'iperereza.
PcosDiagnosis.46: Guhabwa isuzuma rya PCOS ntibituma bishoboka guteganya neza uko bizakugendekera. Iyi syndrome ishobora kugaragara mu buryo butandukanye cane ku muntu umwe n'undi.
PcosDiagnosis.48: PCOS ntivuga ko ugomba kugira kystes.
PcosDiagnosis.51: Amakuru make yateguwe mbere ashobora gufasha umuhanga gusobanukirwa amateka yawe no guhitamo ibizamini bikwiye cane.
PcosDiagnosis.52: Ama cycle yawe amaze igihe kingana iki adahwanye?
PcosDiagnosis.53: Waba warabonye ibiheri, imisatsi ikura mu buryo budasanzwe, canke gutakaza imisatsi?
PcosDiagnosis.54: Mu muryango wanyu hari uwigeze kugira PCOS canke diyabete?
PcosDiagnosis.55: Wifuza gutwita mu gihe gito canke giciriritse?
PcosDiagnosis.57: Niba bishoboka, andika amatariki y'imihango yawe iheruka, uburebure bw'ama cycle yawe bw'ikigereranyo, ibimenyetso wiyumvira, n'imiti canke inyongeramirire ufata.
PcosDiagnosis.59: Isuzuma rishingiye ku bintu byinshi, si ikizamini kimwe.
PcosDiagnosis.60: Ikizamini c'amaraso gishobora gushakisha ihungabana ry'imisemburo no gukuraho izindi mpamvu.
PcosDiagnosis.61: Echographie ishobora kuzuza iperereza bitewe n'uko bimeze.
PcosDiagnosis.62: Ibisubizo bikwiye buri gihe gusobanurwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
PcosDiagnosis.64: Iperereza rya PCOS si ikizamini kimwe cangwa umwanzuro wa nyuma. Rigufasha gusobanukirwa imikorere y'imisemburo yawe, gushakisha izindi mpamvu zishoboka, no kubaka ubuvuzi bubereye uko umeze.
PcosDiagnosis.65: Iyi nyandiko ni iyo kumenyesha gusa kandi ntisimbura inama y'abaganga canke gusobanura ibisubizo vy'ibizamini vyawe ku muntu ku giti cye.
PcosDiagnosis.66: Isuzuma rya PCOS: ibizamini n'iperereza — AWA

PcosHormonalAcne.6: Impamvu ibiheri by'imisemburo bishobora kuza muri PCOS, uko wabimenya, n'ibisubizo bishobora gufasha kubicunga.
PcosHormonalAcne.7: Bigira ingaruka ku bagore benshi kandi si ukubura isuku cangwa ikidashobora kwirindwa: gusobanukirwa inkomoko yabyo bifasha kubicunga neza.
PcosHormonalAcne.10: Kubera iki PCOS ishobora gutera ibiheri?
PcosHormonalAcne.16: Ibiheri by'imisemburo ni ubwoko bw'ibiheri bufitanye isano itaziguye n'ihinduka canke ihungabana ry'imisemburo, cane cane androgènes. Bitandukanye n'ibiheri bisanzwe by'ubugimbi, kenshi bigira ingaruka ku bagore bakuze kandi bishobora gukomeza canke kuza nyuma y'icyo gihe.
PcosHormonalAcne.17: Binatandukanywa n'aho biri, uburebure bwabyo, n'uko bikunda kugaruka ahantu hamwe nubwo wakurikije neza gahunda isanzwe yo kwita ku ruhu.
PcosHormonalAcne.19: Ibiheri by'imisemburo ntibifitanye isano no kubura isuku: koza mu maso kenshi ntibituma bishira, kandi bishobora no gutuma uruhu rwishima.
PcosHormonalAcne.20: Kubera iki PCOS ishobora gutera ibiheri?
PcosHormonalAcne.21: Muri PCOS, androgènes nyinshi ugereranije zitera ibice bitanga amavuta y'uruhu gukora byinshi, bityo bigatanga amavuta menshi. Uruhu rumwe kandi rwumva cane iyi misemburo, ibisobanura impamvu ibiheri bishobora kuba bikomeye nubwo nta ihungabana rikomeye ripimwe muri laboratwari.
PcosHormonalAcne.22: Si ikibazo cy'imbaraga z'umutima: uku kumva ni ukwa buri muntu kandi ntigushingiye ku ngeso zawe z'imibereho.
PcosHormonalAcne.24: Ibimenyetso bimwe kenshi biragaruka, nubwo bitaba buri gihe:
PcosHormonalAcne.25: Igice cyo hasi cy'isura: urwasaya, akananwa
PcosHormonalAcne.26: Ibiheri byimbitse, rimwe na rimwe bibabaza
PcosHormonalAcne.30: Ibiheri by'imisemburo bishobora guhinduka mu cycle yose. Abagore benshi babona kwiyongera mu minsi imbere y'imihango, igihe progestérone izamutse hanyuma ikagwa cane, igatera by'akanya gato amavuta y'uruhu kwiyongera.
PcosHormonalAcne.32: Kwandika igihe ibiheri bigaragara ugereranije na cycle yawe bishobora kugufasha wowe na dermatologue wawe gusobanukirwa neza isano y'imisemburo.
PcosHormonalAcne.34: Ingeso nke zoroheje zo kwita ku ruhu zishobora gufasha kugabanya kwiyongera, nubwo zitabivanaho zonyine:
PcosHormonalAcne.35: Sukura uruhu rwawe buhoro mu gitondo no ku mugoroba
PcosHormonalAcne.36: Irinde ibicuruzwa bikarishye canke bikuraho amavuta yose
PcosHormonalAcne.37: Rinda uruhu rwawe izuba buri munsi
PcosHormonalAcne.39: Bitewe n'uko bimeze, dermatologue canke gynécologue ashobora gutanga imiti yo gusiga (amavuta, gels) canke, niba bikenewe, imiti y'imisemburo ikwiye.
PcosHormonalAcne.41: Imiti y'ibiheri by'imisemburo (yo gusiga canke y'imisemburo) igomba gutegekwa no gukurikiranwa n'umukozi w'ubuzima, cane cane niba wizeye gusama.
PcosHormonalAcne.43: Inama y'abaganga ifasha cane cane mu bihe bimwe:
PcosHormonalAcne.44: Ibiheri bikomeza nubwo wita ku ruhu mu buryo bukwiye
PcosHormonalAcne.46: Ibiheri bikomeye canke birushaho gukomera vuba
PcosHormonalAcne.50: Ibiheri by'imisemburo bifite impamvu imenyekana, ifitanye isano na androgènes.
PcosHormonalAcne.51: Kenshi bigira ingaruka ku gice cyo hasi cy'isura kandi bishobora gukomera imbere y'imihango yawe.
PcosHormonalAcne.52: Si ukubura isuku cangwa ikidashobora kwirindwa.
PcosHormonalAcne.53: Kwita ku ruhu buhoro na, niba bikenewe, ubuvuzi bukwiye bishobora kubigabanya.
PcosHormonalAcne.54: Dermatologue canke gynécologue ashobora kugushigikira niba bikomeje.
PcosHormonalAcne.56: Iyi nyandiko ni iyo kumenyesha muri rusangi kandi ntisimbura inama y'abaganga. Niba ushidikanya canke ibimenyetso bikomeje, saba inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima.

PcosIntro.6: Syndrome des ovaires polykystiques, kenshi yitwa PCOS, ni indwara isanzwe y'imisemburo ishobora kugira ingaruka ku ma cycle yawe, ovulation, uruhu, imisatsi, imikorere y'umubiri, na rimwe na rimwe uburumbuke.
PcosIntro.7: Uko igaragara irahinduka cane ku mugore umwe n'undi. Gusobanukirwa PCOS ahanini bigufasha kumenya ibimenyetso byayo, kumenya igihe cyo gusaba inama y'abaganga, no gukurikirana uko ihinduka uticiraho iteka.
PcosIntro.22: Syndrome des ovaires polykystiques (PCOS) ni indwara isanzwe y'imisemburo ishobora guhindura imikorere isanzwe y'intanga ngore n'uburinganire bw'imisemburo imwe.
PcosIntro.23: Ku bagore bamwe, ikibazo nyamukuru ni ovulation idahwanye. Ku bandi, ni ibiheri, imisatsi myinshi, gutakaza imisatsi, canke ibimenyetso by'imikorere y'umubiri bigaragara mbere.
PcosIntro.25: Nubwo izina ryayo, PCOS ntivuga ko intanga ngore zirimo “kystes”. Ijambo rya kera rishobora kuyobya, kandi echographie yonyine ntihagije ngo hemezwe isuzuma.
PcosIntro.27: Nta mpamvu imwe ya PCOS. Isa n'iterwa n'ibintu byinshi bishobora kwiyongera: umurage mu muryango, imikorere y'imisemburo, ovulation, imikorere y'umubiri, n'ibintu bya buri muntu.
PcosIntro.28: Umurage mu muryango n'ibintu bya génétique
PcosIntro.31: Insuline idakora neza (résistance à l'insuline) ku bagore bamwe
PcosIntro.33: PCOS si ikosa ry'umuntu. Ntiterwa gusa no kubura imbaraga z'umutima, ibiryo bibi, canke imyitozo idahagije.
PcosIntro.35: PCOS ishobora kugaragara mu buryo butandukanye cane ku mugore umwe n'undi. Bamwe bagira ibimenyetso byinshi, abandi bakabona bike cane.
PcosIntro.36: Ama cycle adahwanye, atandukanijwe, canke rimwe na rimwe adahari
PcosIntro.38: Ibiheri bidashira, cane cane ku gice cyo hasi cy'isura
PcosIntro.39: Imisatsi myinshi ku isura, mu gituza, canke ku mubiri
PcosIntro.41: Kongera ibiro canke ingorane zo kubigabanya
PcosIntro.44: Kugira kimwe muri ibi bimenyetso ntibivuga ko ufite PCOS. Indwara nyinshi zindi zishobora gutera ibimenyetso bisa.
PcosIntro.46: Gusuzuma PCOS ni uburyo bw'ubuvuzi. Umukozi w'ubuzima kenshi atangira aganira ku ma cycle yawe, ibimenyetso, amateka y'ubuvuzi, n'imiti iyo ari yo yose ufata.
PcosIntro.47: Bitewe n'uko bimeze, ibizamini by'amaraso by'imisemburo na echographie bishobora na byo gutangwa.
PcosIntro.48: Ama cycle adahwanye canke ovulation idakunze kubaho
PcosIntro.49: Ibimenyetso bya androgènes nyinshi: ibiheri, imisatsi myinshi, gutakaza imisatsi, canke ibisubizo vy'ikizamini c'amaraso
PcosIntro.50: Uko intanga ngore zisa kuri echographie bihuye na PCOS, igihe iri suzuma risabwa
PcosIntro.51: Muganga agomba kandi gukuraho izindi mpamvu zishoboka z'ama cycle adahwanye canke androgènes nyinshi mbere yo kwemeza isuzuma rya PCOS.
PcosIntro.53: Ovulation ni ugusohoka kw'igi (ovocyte) riva mu ntanga ngore. Muri PCOS, ovulation ishobora kuba idakunze canke igoye guteganya.
PcosIntro.54: Ibi bishobora gusobanura impamvu ama cycle rimwe na rimwe aba maremare, adahwanye, canke ugoye kuyateganya.
PcosIntro.56: Kwandika amatariki y'imihango yawe, ibimenyetso, n'ibimenyetso vyose bya ovulation bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza injyana yawe bwite.
PcosIntro.58: Kubera ko ovulation ishobora kuba idahwanye, abagore bamwe bafite PCOS bashobora kugira ingorane nyinshi zo gusama.
PcosIntro.59: Ibi ariko ntibivuga ko PCOS ibuza gutwita. Abagore benshi bafite PCOS basama mu buryo busanzwe canke bafashijwe n'ubuvuzi bukwiye.
PcosIntro.61: Ingorane zo gusama ntizivuga ko bidashoboka. Niba wizeye gutwita, muganga canke umubyaza ashobora kugusaba uburyo bukubereye.
PcosIntro.63: PCOS ishobora kujyana n'ihinduka ry'imikorere y'umubiri, harimo résistance à l'insuline ku bagore bamwe.
PcosIntro.64: Ariko, ibiro byonyine ntibishobora gusuzuma canke gukuraho PCOS. Umugore unanutse ashobora kugira PCOS, nk'uko umugore ufite ibiro byinshi ashobora kutayigira.
PcosIntro.65: Ubuvuzi bukwiye kwita ku buzima muri rusangi, si umubare w'ibiro gusa.
PcosIntro.67: Androgènes nyinshi ugereranije zishobora kugira ingaruka ku bice bitanga amavuta y'uruhu no ku mizi y'imisatsi.
PcosIntro.68: Bitewe n'umugore, ibi bishobora kugaragara nk'ibiheri bidashira, imisatsi myinshi, canke gutakaza imisatsi.
PcosIntro.70: Imisatsi myinshi ku isura canke ku mubiri
PcosIntro.73: Nta buryo bumwe bwo gucunga PCOS bukora kuri buri mugore. Guhitamo biterwa n'ibimenyetso, intego, n'uko ubuvuzi bumeze.
PcosIntro.74: Intego ishobora gutandukana bitewe n'igice cy'ubuzima: gutunganya ama cycle, kunoza ibimenyetso bimwe, kurinda ubuzima bw'imikorere y'umubiri, canke gushigikira gahunda yo gutwita.
PcosIntro.76: Kurya ifunguro ritandukanye, risanzwe kandi ribereye ibyo ukeneye
PcosIntro.77: Gukora imyitozo ngororamubiri isanzwe ushobora gukomezanya igihe kirekire

PcosLifestyleManagement.6: Uburyo bwo gucunga PCOS, n'ingeso zoroheje zo gushigikira ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
PcosLifestyleManagement.16: Gabanya amafunguro kugira ngo wirinde inzara ikaze
PcosLifestyleManagement.17: Gabanya isukari yihuta n'ibiryo byahinduwe cane n'inganda
PcosLifestyleManagement.18: Nta biryo bibujijwe: rondera uburinganire muri rusangi kuruta amategeko akaze
PcosLifestyleManagement.19: Nta muti umwe wa PCOS: ubuvuzi bwuzurizwa ku bimenyetso vyawe, ibyo ushira imbere (cycle, uburumbuke, uruhu, ibiro), n'uko umeze. Bushobora guhuza ingeso z'imibereho, imiti y'imisemburo, canke ubundi buryo bitewe n'ibyo ukeneye.
PcosLifestyleManagement.20: Imyitozo ngororamubiri isanzwe, n'iyo yoroheje (gutambuka vuba, gutwara igare, imyitozo yoroheje y'imbaraga), ifasha gushigikira uburinganire bw'imisemburo n'imikorere y'umubiri. Gukomeza bifite akamaro kuruta ubukana.
PcosLifestyleManagement.21: Gusinzira bihagije no gufata ibihe bisanzwe byo kuruhuka bifasha kugabanya ingaruka z'umunaniro ku buringanire bw'imisemburo, na bwo bushobora kugira ingaruka ku bimenyetso bya PCOS.
PcosLifestyleManagement.23: Impinduka nto, zihoraho kenshi zirusha gukora igihe kirekire impinduka zikomeye zigoye kubungabunga.
PcosLifestyleManagement.24: Kubaho ufite PCOS bishobora kuremerera umutima wawe, cane cane kubera ibimenyetso bigaragara canke impungenge z'uburumbuke. Ibi wiyumvamo birumvikana: kuvugana n'uwo wegereye canke n'umuhanga ni igice cyuzuye cy'ubuvuzi bwuzuye.
PcosLifestyleManagement.26: Ububabare bukomeye canke budasanzwe bwo mu nda yo hasi, kuva amaraso menshi cane canke kumara igihe kirekire, ubunebwe bukabije canke inyota ikomeza idasanzwe, canke agahinda gakomeza uko igihe gihita.
PcosLifestyleManagement.28: PCOS icungwa buri munsi n'ingeso zoroheje no gukurikiranwa n'abaganga buri gihe: buri mpinduka nto irafite akamaro, ku muvuduko wawe.

PcosMetabolism.1:
Ibiro, imikorere y'umubiri, na
résistance à l'insuline
PcosMetabolism.6: Isano iri hagati ya PCOS, ibiro, na résistance à l'insuline — nta guca imanza cangwa inzira z'ubusamo.
PcosMetabolism.8: Isano hagati ya PCOS n'imikorere y'umubiri
PcosMetabolism.14: PCOS kenshi ijyana n'ihinduka ry'imikorere y'umubiri, harimo résistance à l'insuline. Ariko, iyi sano ntireba gusa abagore bafite ibiro byinshi — imiterere y'imikorere y'umubiri iratandukanye ku muntu umwe n'undi.
PcosMetabolism.15: Insuline ni umusemburo ufasha utugingo ngengabuzima gukoresha isukari iri mu maraso. Iyo hari résistance à l'insuline, utugingo twitabira nabi uyu musemburo, kandi umubiri ushobora kwishyura ukora insuline nyinshi.
PcosMetabolism.16: Muri PCOS, ibi bishobora kujyana n'iyongera ry'androgènes kandi bishobora kugira uruhare mu bimenyetso bimwe. Ariko abagore bose bafite PCOS ntibagira imiterere imwe y'imikorere y'umubiri.
PcosMetabolism.18: Résistance à l'insuline ishobora gusuzumwa hakoreshejwe ibizamini by'amaraso igihe muganga abibona bifite akamaro. Niba ibizamini bikenewe biterwa n'uko umeze.
PcosMetabolism.19: PCOS igira ingaruka ku bagore b'ibituro byose, kuva ku bananutse kugeza ku bakomeye.
PcosMetabolism.21: Kugabanya ibiro si ngombwa buri gihe — canke ngo bihagije ku bwabyo — kugira ngo ibimenyetso bigabanuke.
PcosMetabolism.22: Kugabanya ibiro bike bishobora rimwe na rimwe kunoza ibimenyetso bimwe by'imikorere y'umubiri canke guhwanya ama cycle igihe hari ibiro birenze.
PcosMetabolism.23: Intego si ugukurikirana ibiro “bitunganye”, ahubwo ni ukubaka ingeso nyazo, zihoraho. Ifunguro riringaniye, kugenda, no gusinzira buri gihe byose bishobora gutanga umusanzu ku buzima bwiza bw'imikorere y'umubiri.
PcosMetabolism.24: Amafunguro asanzwe, atandukanye kandi arimo fibre nyinshi
PcosMetabolism.25: Imyitozo ngororamubiri isanzwe, n'iyo yaba yoroheje
PcosMetabolism.28: Gukurikiranwa n'abaganga muri PCOS ntigugarukira ku cycle canke ibimenyetso by'imisemburo. Bitewe n'imiterere yawe, umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora no gukurikirana ibimenyetso bimwe by'imikorere y'umubiri kugira ngo afashe kubona hakiri kare ibishobora guteza ingorane.
PcosMetabolism.31: Muganga wawe ashobora guhitamo kugenzura ibimenyetso bimwe bitewe n'ibimenyetso vyawe, amateka yawe y'ubuvuzi, uko umuryango wawe umeze, n'ibindi bintu bishobora guteza ingorane.
PcosMetabolism.33: Isukari mu maraso na/canke HbA1c, bitewe n'uko bimeze
PcosMetabolism.34: Isuzuma ry'ibinure mu maraso (cholestérol na triglycérides)
PcosMetabolism.35: Umuvuduko w'amaraso n'isuzuma ry'ingorane z'umutima n'imitsi
PcosMetabolism.36: Gukurikirana ibiro n'uruzitiro rw'inda, nta guca imanza
PcosMetabolism.38: Ihinduka rimwe rikwiye kuvugwa mu nama y'abaganga, cane cane igihe ari rishasha, rikomeza, canke ridasanzwe kuri wowe.
PcosMetabolism.40: Vuga imihango itandukanijwe cane canke idateganijwe.
PcosMetabolism.42: Vugana na muganga wawe niba ibi bimenyetso bigaragaye mu buryo budasanzwe.
PcosMetabolism.44: Ihinduka ryihuse canke ridasobanutse rikwiye gusuzumwa.
PcosMetabolism.46: Vuga amateka yose y'umuryango ya diyabete canke indwara z'imikorere y'umubiri.
PcosMetabolism.48: Inyota idasanzwe, gusinzira kenshi inkari, ubunebwe bukomeza, canke ihinduka rikomeye, ridasobanutse ry'ibiro bikwiye kumenyeshwa umukozi w'ubuzima. Ibi bimenyetso bishobora kugira impamvu nyinshi kandi ntibyemeza ku bwabyo résistance à l'insuline canke diyabete.
PcosMetabolism.50: Muganga wawe ashobora kugusaba gusuzumwa buri gihe aho kuba iperereza rimwe. Intego ni ugutunganya inama n'ibizamini bijyanye n'uko ugenda utera imbere, utibanda ku biro gusa.
PcosMetabolism.52: Ibiro ni igice kimwe gusa cy'ishusho y'imikorere y'umubiri muri PCOS. Uburyo bwuzuye bwita ku ma cycle, ibimenyetso, ingeso z'imibereho, amateka y'ubuvuzi, n'ibimenyetso by'imikorere y'umubiri.
